name: Lorlatinib (next-generation ALK/ROS1 inhibitor)
supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
Monitor lipids, mood/cognitive effects (CNS), and weight.

drugs.name: Lorlatinib
drugs.notes: Lorlatinib 100 mg PO once daily, continuous, as a resistance-guided next-generation inhibitor after earlier ALK/ROS1 TKIs (repotrectinib is an alternative in ROS1-rearranged disease). Flat oral dose modeled per day of the cycle. My own wording.
